note: v1858: The swept ledger was the only one of five live-state files with no isolation override, so anything but a unittest wrote his real memory of what has been swept. And v1856s template report sat beside the skip-set, which runs before the sweep, so its counter was always zero and the line could never print - plumbing with no tap, written into the commit that removed some. Both found by an isolated end-to-end run on real frames.
